history.description: AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.46: Digital Pass Event Details & Metadata Cascading: Upgraded DigitalPass.jsx to cascade event resolution across nested registration.event, flattened registration.* fields, api.getCachedEvents(), and initialEvents. Replaced hardcoded 'March 2026' placeholder with official festival date '02-11-2026' and localized Kannada representation '೦೨ ನವೆಂಬರ್, ೨೦೨೬'. Corrected event fallback title to resolve Kannada and English titles properly instead of showing raw event IDs.; Student Dashboard Pass & Card Metadata: Replaced 'March 2026' in StudentDashboard.jsx registered events list with actual event dates (defaulting to '02-11-2026'). Enriched backend get_student_dashboard in student.py to return reporting_time, venue_kn, rules_en, rules_kn, and structured event object for all registrations.; Official PDF Pass Generation Event Customization: Enriched backend download_event_pass and id_card_service.py to inject event_title, event_date, and venue into candidate ID card PDFs, displaying the registered competition name on the pass badge and embedding event metadata in the QR verification payload.; SuperAdmin & Admin Attendance Edit Timestamp Fix: Added parse_ist_time_string_to_utc in timezone.py to safely parse 12-hour AM/PM (%I:%M:%S %p), 24-hour, and ISO time strings. Resolved ValueError crashes in edit_attendance_record and edit_wc_attendance_record that previously reset modified check-in/check-out timestamps to current server UTC time.; Future Festival Date Attendance Marking Override: Enabled SUPERADMIN and DEVELOPER override in verify_attendance_date_is_open and verify_wc_attendance_date_is_open so administrators can manage, test, and pre-mark attendance for configured festival dates (2026-10-30 to 2026-11-04) without being blocked by premature date checks.; Working Committee Attendance Marking & Session Lock Fix: Resolved issue in SuperAdminDashboard and working_committee_attendance.py where submitted sessions locked the Present/Absent marking buttons. Allowed Superadmin and Developer direct marking and editing overrides, broadened WC member eligibility verification to include all recognized working committee users and roster records, and unlocked submitted past test session.; Volunteer Profile ID Card Removal: Removed 'View Official ID Card' action button and VolunteerIDCardModal container from MyProfileAttendance.jsx and StudentDashboard.jsx, cleanly stripping ID card viewing from volunteer and student profiles.; Volunteer Attendance Marking in SuperAdmin & Developer Portal: Granted DEVELOPER and DEV-NANU full administrative privileges in require_admin (auth_deps.py) and verify_session_not_locked (attendance.py), eliminating HTTP 403 Forbidden errors and enabling seamless volunteer check-in and check-out in both SuperAdmin and Developer portals.; Festival Highlights Banner Upload in Developer Portal: Enabled DEVELOPER authentication on POST /media/image and added an automatic local Data URL FileReader fallback in EventImageUpload.jsx so highlight creation is never blocked even if cloud storage encounters network latency.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.45: Official 2026 Calendar & Plan Poster Integration: Converted and optimized user-provided Kannada and English calendars into high-resolution WebP and PNG formats (calendar-2026.webp, calendar-2026-kannada.webp, calendar-2026.png, calendar-2026-kannada.png, rajyotsava-draft-poster.jpg).; Header & Modal Title Update: Updated text from 'Karunada Vaibhava 2026 - Official Draft Plan Poster' to 'Karunada Vaibhava 2026 - Official Plan Poster' (and Kannada equivalent 'ಕರುನಾಡ ವೈಭವ ೨೦೨೬ - ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಪೋಸ್ಟರ್') across KarunadaVaibhavaSchedule.jsx, siteConfig.js, and index.html.; Bilingual Calendar Viewer & HD Download: Added one-tap Kannada/English language switcher and direct 300 DPI HD download button directly inside the full-screen poster modal for both mobile and desktop.; Direct Inline Calendar Tab: Added a tabbed view in the Karunada Vaibhava Schedule section allowing users to switch between the 5-day schedule cards and the inline Official Plan Calendar showcase without needing to open a popup.; Mobile Modal Upgrade: Replaced mobile 'Coming soon...' placeholder with the live responsive calendar viewer.; Post-Registration WhatsApp Group Popup & Persistent Access: Created WhatsAppGroupModal.jsx and config/whatsappGroups.js mapping event registrations (Reel Contest, Sketching Competition, Painting Competition, Rangoli Competition, Mehendi Competition) to official WhatsApp groups. Automatically displays an interactive popup modal upon each registration in ConfirmationPage and StudentDashboard, accompanied by direct WhatsApp access buttons in DigitalPass and registered event rosters.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.44: Event Selection Memory & Post-Auth Automatic Redirection: Stored selectedEventId in sessionStorage ('akv_pending_event_id') whenever a user taps 'Register Now' on any event card, modal, or banner, preventing lost selections across pages and reloads.; EventsPage One-Click Event Registration Routing: Upgraded handleRegisterEvent in EventsPage.jsx to route directly to '/register' with preloaded event details if authenticated, or to '/student?mode=register' when unauthenticated.; AuthPortal Event-Aware Onboarding: Added pending event banner in AuthPortal.jsx displaying the competition title being registered for, and dynamically customized post-registration success button to 'Continue Event Registration for [Event Name]' routing straight to the event form.; RegisterPage Immediate Step 2 Restoration: Configured RegisterPage.jsx to automatically populate candidate details from the newly registered user session, jump straight to Step 2 for the chosen event, and purge pending session keys upon successful submission.; StudentDashboard Modal Auto-Trigger: Added initialEventId handling to StudentDashboard.jsx to automatically trigger quick registration modals (Reel Contest, Solo rules, or Team modal) if an event ID is passed into the dashboard.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.43: Reel Contest Unique Identifier (AKV-NT-REEL) Disambiguation: Resolved collision where ID 'AKV-NT-11' was already registered to the manually created 'Painting' event in production PostgreSQL; assigned dedicated canonical ID 'AKV-NT-REEL' across seed.py, eventsData.js, HomePage, and InstagramSection.; Database Self-Healing & Title Check: Updated /api/events to check both event ID and title_en to guarantee 'Reel Contest' is seeded and kept active without overwriting existing manually created competitions.; Registration Data Safety Migration: Added automatic query migrating any previous reel contest registrations from 'AKV-NT-11' to 'AKV-NT-REEL'.; Frontend Storage Cache Bump (v4): Bumped STORAGE_EVENTS_KEY to akv_events_cache_v4 to immediately invalidate stale browser caches and display the Reel Contest alongside all manually created events.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.42: PostgreSQL Schema Auto-Migration Fix: Bumped CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION to 5 in database.py, enabled fast-path check in ensure_schema_migrations() on Vercel, and hooked migration check into get_db() and on_startup to guarantee newly defined columns (such as registrations.instagram_username and registrations.instagram_profile_link) are automatically provisioned in production PostgreSQL without container timeouts.; Event Deletion Registration Cleanup Hardening: Upgraded DELETE /api/events/{event_id} in events.py to query only registration_id using targeted raw SQL instead of projecting full Registration ORM models, eliminating psycopg.errors.UndefinedColumn errors during event deletions.; Reel Contest Event Website Display & Backend Self-Healing Resilience: Enhanced backend /api/events self-healing to guarantee that the official Reel Contest (AKV-NT-11) is always present and active, purging any conflicting AuditLog EVENT_DELETED markers, and added on-the-fly healing in /api/events/{event_id}.; Frontend Cache & Local Storage Upgrade: Bumped STORAGE_EVENTS_KEY to akv_events_cache_v3 and STORAGE_DELETED_EVENTS_KEY to v2; updated getLocalEvents() and getEvents() to permanently ensure initialEvents (Reel Contest) can never be suppressed by stale client cache; protected Reel Contest from accidental client-side deletion; and updated EventsPage.jsx to reliably render events on revalidation.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.41: Backend Event Configuration & Seeding Restricted Exclusively to Reel Contest: Configured backend seed.py INITIAL_EVENTS and frontend eventsData.js initialEvents to contain strictly the official 'Reel Contest' (AKV-NT-11). Removed all other initial festival events (AKV-NT-01 through AKV-NT-10) from backend initial seeds, startup migrations, and self-healing insertion, allowing Superadmins to manually add and configure all other festival events directly from the SuperAdmin portal.; SuperAdmin Event Deletion Fix & Auto-Resurrection Elimination: Resolved the bug where deleted events immediately reappeared in the Superadmin portal; updated backend /api/events self-healing and seed.py to check AuditLog for EVENT_DELETED, ensuring deliberately deleted events are never re-seeded or resurrected automatically.; Frontend Deleted Events Storage & Cache Invalidation: Added client-side deleted event tracking (markEventAsDeleted/getDeletedEventIds) in api.js, stopped unconstrained merging of initialEvents over live backend catalog responses, and purged memory/localStorage caches on event deletion.; Case-Insensitive Event Deletion & Foreign Key Cascading: Upgraded DELETE /api/events/{event_id} in events.py to match event IDs case-insensitively, clean up corresponding registrations and check-in logs safely to prevent PostgreSQL foreign key constraint errors, and flush before event record deletion.; SuperAdmin Portal UX & Edit Modal Deletion: Integrated a dedicated handleDeleteEvent handler in SuperAdminDashboard with confirmation dialog, event registrations refresh, and added a convenient Delete button directly inside the Edit Fest Event modal.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.40: Reel Contest Website Discoverability & Universal Catalog Synchronization: Synchronized all 11 official festival events (AKV-NT-01 through AKV-NT-11) into frontend eventsData.js initialEvents and backend seed.py INITIAL_EVENTS; added self-healing auto-insertion in backend /events API ensuring Reel Contest is dynamically seeded into production PostgreSQL databases without requiring cold-start migrations; added prominent Reel Contest 2026 Spotlight Banner in InstagramSection on the homepage with 1-click registration routing; updated Day 6 festival schedule in siteConfig.js to showcase Reel Contest; preserved seamless cache merging in api.js.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.39: Backend Python Startup Fix: Added missing import os in backend/app/auth_deps.py and backend/app/seed.py preventing NameError crash during database seeding and superadmin initialization.; Reel Contest Event Integration & SuperAdmin Event Configuration Suite: Added official 'Reel Contest' (AKV-NT-11) event to backend seed (INITIAL_EVENTS) and database schema with cultural category, solo format, and festival guidelines; created dedicated registration form with regular participant details (Name, AUID, Institute, Department, Year, Section, Phone, Email, Gender) and Instagram submission fields (Username & Profile Link) across RegisterPage and StudentDashboard; added Instagram columns to SuperAdmin Excel and Admin CSV exports; enhanced SuperAdmin Event Configuration with prominent, robust 'Edit Event' option and feedback; preserved 100% isolation for all other events.; Student Registration Robust Response Parsing & Backend Availability: Upgraded studentRegister, forgotPassword, verifyResetOtp, and resetPassword in frontend api.js to use safe readApiResponse() instead of raw res.json(), preventing uncaught 'Unexpected end of JSON input' syntax errors when backend servers return empty or gateway error bodies; corrected isNetworkError() condition; verified live uvicorn backend on port 8000 and Vite proxy connectivity.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.38: Google Sheets Sync Webhook URL Strict Validation & Document Link Guard: Added robust frontend and backend validation intercepting incorrect Google Spreadsheet document links (docs.google.com/spreadsheets/...) or /dev test URLs before submission, preventing invalid POST dispatch.; Actionable HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed Diagnostics: Enhanced backend google_sheets_service.py and frontend api.js to provide clear, human-readable troubleshooting guidance explaining when Google Apps Script is missing doPost() or requires publishing a 'New version' under Manage deployments.; Real-Time Webhook Format Badges: Integrated live URL validation indicators in SuperAdminDashboard.jsx and DeveloperGoogleSheetsSync.jsx that dynamically alert users when a spreadsheet link or /dev test URL is detected, confirming valid /exec webhook formats.; Turnkey Apps Script Instructions & Troubleshooting Callouts: Added prominent HTTP 405 troubleshooting walkthroughs directly inside SuperAdminDashboard and DeveloperGoogleSheetsSync Apps Script modals, as well as in Code.gs header documentation.; Removal of Preloaded Festival Highlights: Emptied hardcoded festivalHighlights array in highlightsData.js, upgraded storage key to v2, and configured HighlightsSection to gracefully hide when no highlights exist until configured by Superadmins.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.37: Highlights of Nuditaranga 2026 Section: Added a dedicated, bilingual Highlights section (HighlightsSection.jsx) on the homepage and festival portals featuring 6 core flagship experiences (Karnataka Rajyotsava & Flag Hoisting, Kala Ranga Yakshagana & Theatre, Karunada Jatre Carnival, Literary Conclave & Quiz, Musical Nite & Valedictory Gala, and 25+ Inter-College Competitions), dynamic category filters, interactive detail modals, and navigation routes.; Superadmin Festival Highlights Manager: Empowered Superadmins to manage festival highlights directly from SuperAdminDashboard.jsx without backend database changes. Added 'Nuditaranga Highlights' navigation tab, full CRUD interface with photo upload via EventImageUpload, bilingual Kannada/English fields, card glow gradient selectors, reordering controls, defaults reset, JSON import/export, and instant client-side synchronization via localStorage and memory cache.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.36: Auid.png Layout Design for Volunteers ID Card: Converted 'Auid.png' into the official high-resolution, pixel-perfect template design for all volunteer ID cards across frontend modal preview and backend PDF generation.; Cleaned Ornate Template Assets (auid-clean.png): Extracted and cleaned 'Auid.png' into 'frontend/public/images/auid-clean.png', preserving the rich Karnataka heritage artwork (Mysore Ambari elephant with rider, Vijayanagara Hampi stone chariot, Mysore Palace crimson silhouette, Indian Roller bird, and Karunada Vaibhava map) while removing placeholder sample text.; Interactive Volunteer ID Card Modal (VolunteerIDCardModal.jsx): Updated front face to use the 'auid-clean.png' artwork with precise CSS percentage overlays for volunteer photo, centered volunteer name, and structured values for AUID, Institute, and Domain in the translucent peach info card.; Dual-Engine 2-Page PDF Generator (id_card_service.py): Upgraded _generate_volunteer_id_card_pdf to render a 2-page print-ready PDF (Page 1 = Auid.png layout with rounded photo clipping and aligned credentials; Page 2 = QR code verification pass, structured identity table, and festival guidelines over Karnataka temple skyline).; Developer Contact Email Update: Updated Ayush H Mane's official contact mail ID across the student coordinator contact card in siteConfig.js, portal settings modal (PortalSettingsModal.jsx), backend superadmin identity configurations (auth_deps.py, auth.py, init_superadmins.py), and database records to 'ayushh.23.beai@acharya.ac.in'.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.35: Scheduled Maintenance Mode Activation (till 10:00 AM, 16th October 2026): Configured non-destructive maintenance mode across frontend and backend, displaying a dedicated bilingual Maintenance Notice on all visitor and portal routes.; Bilingual Maintenance Notice Screen (MaintenancePage.jsx): Implemented a premium dark-themed notice featuring a live countdown clock to 10:00 AM 16th October 2026 IST, official AKV branding, and support contacts.; Zero-Harm Database & Data Safety Guarantee: Completely preserved all database tables, student profiles, event registrations, and attendance records 100% intact and undamaged.; Automatic Resumption & Staff Bypass: Integrated auto-expiry at 10:00 AM 16th October 2026 to automatically restore access, along with an authorized coordinator/developer passcode bypass (`akv2026dev`) and /developer access.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.34: Developer Portal Briefcase Icon Reference Error Fix: Added missing Briefcase import from lucide-react in DeveloperSuperAdminManager.jsx, resolving runtime ReferenceError: Briefcase is not defined when opening the Developer Portal (/developer).; Build Verification: Verified clean production build using npm run build with 0 warnings or errors.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.33: Developer Portal Volunteer & Admin Profile Edit Suite: Integrated comprehensive profile editing options across the Developer Portal (/developer) and Superadmin Dashboard for all registered Volunteers and Administrators (Faculty Coordinators, Working Committee Heads, and General Admins).; Unified Developer Profiles & Accounts Manager: Expanded DeveloperSuperAdminManager into a multi-directory console with instant sub-tab navigation between Superadmin Profiles, Admins & Faculty Profiles, and Volunteer Profiles featuring real-time plaintext password visibility, copy controls, and 1-click 'Edit Profile' actions.; Dedicated Modal Components (EditAdminModal & EditVolunteerModal): Created reusable, responsive modal dialogs supporting full modifications of Core Identity (Full Name, Username, Email, Phone, AUID / Faculty ID), Academic Details (Institute, Department, Semester, Section, Gender), Assigned Vedike Domains, System Roles (Volunteer vs Participant, Admin designations), Approval & Account Statuses (Approved, Pending, Rejected, Active, Disabled), and optional password resets.; Backend REST API Endpoints & Audit Logging: Implemented PUT /api/superadmin/admins/{admin_id}, PUT /api/superadmin/volunteers/{user_id}, PUT /api/developer/admins/{admin_id}, and PUT /api/developer/volunteers/{user_id} with unique constraint enforcement, developer root account protection, password hashing, in-memory cache invalidation (FastCache), and persistent AuditLog tracking.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.32: Database Log Query Performance Optimization: Added high-performance compound B-Tree indexes for audit_logs (action + created_at DESC, action + id DESC, created_at DESC, target_type + target_id, user_id), attendance_audit_logs (date + modified_at DESC, user_id + modified_at DESC, modified_at DESC), working_committee_audit_logs (date + modified_at DESC, member_id + modified_at DESC, modified_at DESC), and checkin_logs (registration_id + timestamp DESC, timestamp DESC), eliminating sequential scans and in-memory sort stalls on Supabase PostgreSQL.; Backend Audit Query Safety & Projection: Applied load_only column projection and safe-limit bounds (max 200) across /superadmin/audit-logs, /attendance/audit, and /working-committee-attendance/audit; resolved Google Sheets config audit log schema persistence.; Website Performance & Core Web Vitals (CWV) Optimization: Code-split non-home routes (StudentDashboard, AuthPortal, EventsPage, RegisterPage) using React.lazy, slashing the initial entrypoint JS bundle from 373 kB to 162 kB (56.5% reduction); converted public brand logos and festival mascot (akv-logo, acharya-logo, nograj) to modern WebP with backward-compatible picture fallback, eliminating over 4.1 MB of image bandwidth; added Supabase CDN preconnect and brand logo preloads with fetchpriority='high' in index.html to drastically accelerate Largest Contentful Paint (LCP).; Full-Stack API Call Optimization & Deduplication Engine: Eliminated database N+1 queries in get_today_volunteers by batch-loading volunteer attendance with .in_(vol_ids) (slashing queries from up to 200+ to just 2); implemented FastCache thread-safe in-memory caching and prefix invalidation across admin overview, volunteer attendance, working committee rosters, attendance stats, and developer diagnostics; unified events cache key normalization; implemented client-side in-flight promise deduplication and scoped memory caching in api.js for getCurrentUser, getMyRegistrations, getAdminOverview, getTodayVolunteers, getWorkingCommitteeStats, getWorkingCommitteeMembers, and developer health telemetry; added instant client-side in-memory category filtering for events and activities that returns in 0ms without hitting the network when complete catalogs are cached; integrated session-safe cache clearing on login/logout in AuthContext.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.31: Production Base64 Image Migration Completed (Steps 34-36): Migrated all 10 legacy Base64 images from PostgreSQL across activities, gallery_items, and social_posts into optimized WebP objects in the public Supabase Storage bucket 'akv-media' via PostgREST HTTPS API, reducing database payload size by ~1.90 MB and achieving 0 remaining Base64 records in the database.; Phase 4 Production Index Audit & Verification (Steps 46-50): Verified 100% object integrity across Supabase Storage and PostgreSQL database records (10/10 verified active HTTP 200 WebP objects, 0 orphaned objects, 0 broken links); verified clean frontend production builds (vite build passed 0 errors) and linter checks; verified backend API modules, schemas, and Pillow/httpx dependencies in requirements.txt; cataloged production pg_indexes audit and idempotent index creation DDL for database execution.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.30: Step 37 Base64 Ingestion Blocker: Enforced strict validation across ActivityCreate, ActivityUpdate, GalleryItemCreate, GalleryItemUpdate, SocialPostCreate, and SocialPostUpdate schemas in backend/app/schemas.py, immediately rejecting any incoming data:image/... Base64 payloads with HTTP 422 while accepting valid HTTP/HTTPS and asset URLs.; Step 39 & 34 Media Dimension Normalization & Pillow WebP Processing: Configured automatic downscaling for uploaded and migrated images exceeding 1,600px maximum dimension using Pillow Lanczos resampling, converted photographic formats to WebP (quality 80) in backend/app/routes/media.py and backend/app/supabase_storage.py.; Step 34-36 Standalone Base64 Migration Engine & Safe Retries: Enhanced scripts/migrate_base64_images_to_storage.py with stable storage paths (`legacy/{table}/{id}.webp`), conditional updates (updating DB only if the column still contains Base64), batch limit support (`--max-records 5` for Step 35 tiny batch verification), and automatic orphan storage object tracking.; Step 44 Public Catalog Pagination & Prefix Cache Purging: Added optional limit (1-200) and offset query parameters to GET /api/activities, GET /api/gallery, and GET /api/reels while maintaining backward-compatible complete array responses for unpaginated callers and wiring fast_cache.delete_prefix() invalidation on create, edit, and delete mutations.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.29: Account-Aware Catalog Prefetch & Gallery/Reels Decoupling: Updated api.prefetchAll() in api.js to use an account-aware prefetchKey (`${role}:${identity}`) with 60s debounce, fetching active-only events, schedule, and activities for initial loading while removing background gallery and reels calls so those media-heavy datasets are loaded strictly on-demand when users navigate to their respective sections.; Frontend Attendance Config Dates Snapshot Caching: Added dedicated 30-second memory cache snapshot (ATTENDANCE_CONFIG_DATES_TTL_MS) to api.getAttendanceConfigDates() in api.js, preventing redundant network requests and database query storms when switching filters, departments, or dates in Admin and SuperAdmin dashboards.; Events API Response 15s Browser Memory Caching & Invalidation: Added dedicated responseCacheKey (events_api_{category}_{activeOnly}) with 15-second TTL in api.getEvents(), preventing repeated API requests within the same browser session; wired automatic invalidateMemCache('events_api_') into createEvent(), updateEvent(), deleteEvent(), and studentRegisterEvent() (including offline fallback) to guarantee instantaneous UI freshness.; Student Dashboard Query Projection Optimization (load_only): Applied SQLAlchemy load_only column filtering in backend/app/routes/student.py for registrations, eager-loaded events, volunteer attendance, working committee attendance, and official attendance records, eliminating transfer of unneeded columns and heavy JSON payloads while preserving complete response structures and attendance histories.; Student My-Registrations N+1 Elimination & Eager Column Projection: Upgraded /student/my-registrations in student.py with single-query joinedload(Registration.event) and load_only projections, eliminating N+1 lazy-load database lookups per registration and projecting only required event and registration fields.; Activities API Response 30s Browser Memory Caching & Invalidation: Configured responseCacheKey (activities_api_{category}_{activeOnly}) with 30-second TTL in api.getActivities(), eliminating repeat network requests within the same browser session; wired automatic invalidateMemCache('activities_api_') across all createActivity(), updateActivity(), and deleteActivity() API success and offline fallback branches.; Scoped Gallery Memory Cache & Mutation Invalidation: Added dedicated invalidateGalleryCache() helper and 30-second category-scoped in-memory caching in api.getGallery() (gallery_{category}), with automatic cache purging across createGalleryItem(), updateGalleryItem(), and deleteGalleryItem() to eliminate redundant gallery payload re-fetching.; Scoped Reels & Posts Memory Cache & Mutation Invalidation: Added dedicated invalidateReelsCache() helper and 30-second post-type-scoped in-memory caching in api.getReels() (reels_{postType}), with automatic cache purging across createReel(), updateReel(), and deleteReel() to prevent repeat network downloads while preserving instant mutation updates.; Student Dashboard 15s User-Scoped Memory Cache & Safe In-Flight Cleanup: Added user-specific 15-second TTL in-memory caching in api.getStudentDashboard() keyed by student AUID (dash_{auid}), with invalidateCurrentStudentDashboardFreshness() cache purging on event registrations and conditional in-flight request cleanup ensuring older requests cannot accidentally clear newer ones.; Festival Schedule 60s Memory Caching & Immediate Edit Synchronization: Configured 60-second TTL memory cache (festival_schedule_api) in api.getFestivalSchedule() via getFromMemCache(), preventing repeat GET requests on route transitions while preserving force-fresh reloads; synchronized updateFestivalSchedule() to immediately write edited schedules to festival_schedule_api, memCache, and local storage for zero-lag UI updates.; Admin Dashboard Overview Decoupled from Filter Changes: Isolated api.getAdminOverview() from routine attendance roster filter modifications (department, AKV domain, status, date) in AdminPage.jsx using overviewLoadedRef, preventing redundant overview query loops on filter changes while preserving fresh overview reloads on explicit refresh and invalidating the ref upon check-in/check-out events.; Public Activities CDN Cache-Control Optimization: Configured conditional Cache-Control headers in backend/app/routes/activities.py returning public, max-age=15, s-maxage=60, stale-while-revalidate=120 for public active-only queries to leverage Vercel shared CDN caching, while strictly returning no-store for administrative requests including inactive records.; Public Gallery & Reels Shared CDN Cache-Control Optimization: Configured Cache-Control: public, max-age=15, s-maxage=60, stale-while-revalidate=120 on GET /api/gallery in gallery.py and GET /api/reels in reels.py (with no-store fallback for inactive reels), enabling edge reuse across multiple public visitors while safeguarding administrative management routes.; Media Egress Optimization & Below-The-Fold Asynchronous Lazy Loading: Added loading='lazy' and decoding='async' across all below-the-fold image collections including GallerySection, ActivitiesSection, InstagramSection, AdminPage gallery, SuperAdminDashboard activities and reels, and schedule modals, preventing off-screen media downloads while keeping hero brand images eagerly rendered (loading='eager').; Supabase Storage On-Demand Image Transformation Helper: Implemented optimizePublicSupabaseImageUrl in frontend/src/utils/imageUrl.js and integrated into GallerySection.jsx and ActivitiesSection.jsx, targeting standard public Supabase Storage objects (/storage/v1/render/image/public/) with width and quality constraints for auto-WebP delivery while preserving external and local media intact.; Supabase Storage Media Infrastructure & Server-Side Migration Engine: Configured backend/app/supabase_storage.py and settings (SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, SUPABASE_STORAGE_BUCKET='akv-media') for server-side object storage dispatch, along with scripts/migrate_base64_images_to_storage.py for batch-migrating Base64 records from PostgreSQL into CDN object storage without exposing service secrets to client bundles.; Secure Backend Image-Upload API (POST /api/media/image): Implemented authenticated administrator media upload router in backend/app/routes/media.py with strict file size (<10MB) and pixel dimension limits (<20 megapixels), automatic in-memory Pillow conversion to high-efficiency WebP, and direct async streaming to Supabase Storage ('akv-media'), eliminating Base64 payload storage and returning public CDN URLs.; Client-Side Direct Storage Integration (EventImageUpload.jsx & api.uploadImage): Wired frontend image upload component directly to POST /api/media/image with client-side mime validation, file size validation, progress state, and error handling, storing CDN image URLs in database records instead of bloated Base64 strings while preserving URL-paste fallback.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.28: Google Sheets Sync Zero-Timeout Engine & Direct Browser Dispatch: Eliminated N+1 round-trip SQL loops in build_google_sheets_payload reducing database compile latency from >10s to <150ms; added direct client-to-webhook browser dispatch in api.syncGoogleSheets with CORS-safelisted payload streaming to bypass Vercel serverless FUNCTION_INVOCATION_TIMEOUT limits; optimized Google Apps Script (Code.gs) with batch setRowHeights and static column sizing, slashing spreadsheet sync time from 20s to <2s.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.27: Google Sheets Sync Database Persistence & Serverless Resilience: Enhanced get_google_sheets_config and save_google_sheets_config to persist configuration in database AuditLog and /tmp, guaranteeing persistent Webhook URLs across Vercel serverless cold starts.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.26: Google Spreadsheet Live Multi-Sheet Attendance & Volunteer Sync: Connected Google Spreadsheet (ID: 1jDIzvpZSWe_PBFMzYAsR4wMaMcSvK4VO95URw7jsYAc) with automated multi-sheet synchronization across 17 structured worksheets (Volunteer Master Directory, 14 department domain attendance sheets, Working Committee roster, and Consolidated Attendance).; Public Volunteer Photo Serving Endpoint: Added public GET /api/users/{identifier}/photo supporting binary decoding of base64 photos, remote image redirects, and branded SVG avatar fallbacks, enabling live formula-based =IMAGE() rendering and direct clickable links in Google Sheets.; Google Apps Script Turnkey Engine: Created scripts/google_apps_script/Code.gs providing automated sheet creation, header styling with Karnataka crimson (#8B0000) and gold accents, frozen header panes, auto-fitted columns, IST timestamp conversions, and custom UI menu in Google Sheets.; SuperAdmin Dashboard Google Sheets Integration Suite: Added dedicated Google Spreadsheet Live Attendance & Volunteer Sync hero module in the Exports section with direct spreadsheet access, Webhook URL configuration, 1-click sync trigger, Apps Script code copier modal, and JSON payload previewer.; Developer Portal Google Sheets Live Sync Suite: Mounted dedicated DeveloperGoogleSheetsSync console into the Developer Portal (/developer) with real-time terminal activity stream, webhook configuration, direct spreadsheet launch, JSON payload inspection, Apps Script code copier, and public photo stream live preview tester.; Standalone Python Sync CLI: Developed scripts/sync_google_sheets.py supporting dry runs, payload dumping, and command-line execution for background automated synchronization.
